title: Unreliable-connection sale registration trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for sales-api-unreliable-connection trace events.

online.description: Whether the client currently has a connection to the server.

sales.description: The client's durable local queue, in the order the sales were recorded.

id.description: The client-generated idempotency key of this sale.

attempts.description: How many send attempts this sale has already used.

nextRetryMs.description: Exponential backoff delay before the next attempt; 0 once confirmed.

server.description: The server's idempotency store: one record per key it has ever applied.

response.description: The stored response replayed for every later request with this key.

serverTotal.description: Total amount actually registered on the server.

duplicateCount.description: Requests the idempotency store recognised and applied nothing for.

doubleChargeCount.description: Sales registered twice because a retry arrived under a new key.

attempt.description: The last send attempt (absent before the first one and after a drain).
